name: sc
description: SwarmCloud from inside a Claude Code session. Two skills: `sc` reads the cluster -- the account pool and its quota windows, which pool actually binds each runner profile, what is running, what is wrong -- and never writes. `delegate` owns the decision to run work remotely instead of locally, dispatches it by runner-profile NAME from the frozen catalogue, reports a failure as something actionable rather than a task id, and brings the result back into the working tree. It writes, so it says when it asks first. Four agents and a workflow run a Claude Code workflow's steps in SwarmCloud while each still shows as a running row: `sc:remote` runs one step remotely, and `/sc:swarmcloud` runs a whole SwarmCloud workflow spec with an `sc:step` row per step, and `sc:wait` spaces a row's retries while the bridge is down. `delegate` works through the plugin's own MCP server, which fetches the swarm-mcp bridge from GitHub at the tag matching this version and needs only uv. The `sc` skill and /sc run `uv run sc` in the session's directory, so they need a checkout of this repository.

deployment_url.title: SwarmCloud deployment URL
deployment_url.description: The address of YOUR SwarmCloud deployment -- the load balancer for a team deployment (e.g. https://swarm.example.com), or the *.run.app address for a solo one. Your platform operator knows it.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth client ID (Desktop app)
oauth_client_id.description: The deployment's Desktop app OAuth client ID (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com). Your operator creates one per deployment and allowlists it on IAP; with it you sign in as yourself with `sc login`. Leave empty for a solo deployment without IAP.

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth client secret (Desktop app)
oauth_client_secret.description: The secret of that same Desktop app OAuth client (starts GOCSPX-). Stored in your system's secure credential store, never in settings.json. Leave empty for a solo deployment without IAP.

default_target.title: Default target for dispatched work
default_target.description: Where the dispatching tools send work when a call does not say: cloud (dispatch it to SwarmCloud), local (send nothing; the work runs in this session), or hybrid (a unit that names a runner profile goes to the cloud unless the call declares needs_local -- filesystem, keychain or interactive -- in which case it stays local). A call's own target overrides this for that call only. Any other value stops the plugin's server at start-up.

auto_attach.title: Show running SwarmCloud workflows at session start
auto_attach.description: When on, a new or resumed session in which this plugin is configured lists your tenant's SwarmCloud workflows that are still running (read-only, a few seconds at most, silent when none run or SwarmCloud cannot be reached) and is told to run /sc attach --all first, which shows them as live [SwarmCloud] rows. Turn off to start sessions without it; /sc attach --all still works by hand.
